name: Cocoa
description: Cocoa supply is concentrated in West Africa and shaped by weather, crop disease, farm economics, port logistics, grinding demand, inventories, and contract structure.

benchmark.name: ICE U.S. Cocoa futures
benchmark.delayPolicy: Provider-defined; use the displayed as-of timestamp.
benchmark.caveat: The futures quote does not represent every origin differential or local farm-gate price.

marketContext: Read the futures benchmark beside crop arrivals, weather, disease reports, farm incentives, port movement, certified stocks, grindings, and origin differentials. Production evidence and contract pricing update on different calendars. A sharp futures move can therefore precede confirmed crop data or reflect positioning as well as physical supply.
